# 2 bed cottage for sale

> New to the market this spacious detached three bedroom cottage set on an elevated C.1 acre site, conveniently located just 1km from the N4 at Castlebaldwin. In need of complete refurbishment and modernisation, this property presents an excellent opportunity for renovation and may qualify for the Derelict Property Refurbishment Grant (subject to eligibility criteria).

- Dispozice: 2 bed
- Plocha: 80.1 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Bricklieve, Castlebaldwin
